question: What public signals suggest builders need better ways to decide which Apify Actor is worth paying for?
arena: Apify Actor marketplace and paid web data

sources.title: Apify Actor Ideas
sources.summary: Apify presents Actor ideas across categories such as scrapers, API wrappers, AI tools, and agents.

signals.text: There are many possible Actor categories, which creates a source-selection problem for builders.
A useful meta-tool would help builders choose an Actor idea and explain why it is worth building or running.

sources.title: Website Content Crawler
sources.summary: The Actor crawls websites and extracts clean text or Markdown for LLM, RAG, and AI application use cases.

signals.text: The Actor is already positioned for feeding AI models, which makes it a strong candidate for evidence collection.
The Actor retrieves useful content, but it does not decide whether the crawl was worth paying for.

sources.title: Google Search Scraper
sources.summary: The Actor can discover search results and candidate public sources for a question.

signals.text: Search discovery produces candidate sources, but the agent still needs a ranking method for what to crawl next.
Search is an early paid/live call, so it needs a ledger entry explaining why the call was made.

ledger.reason: Seed the demo with known Apify idea context before API wiring

ledger.cost_proxy: pay per usage when run on Apify
